reviews.title: Not Worth It
reviews.text:
Honestly, I wouldn’t recommend this app. There are way too many ads, and all it really does is count the days. It includes holidays but completely leaves out Ramadan and Eid, which are very important dates for Muslims. There isn’t even an Islamic calendar.

I expected a countdown app to offer more useful features and allow people from different religions and cultures to track their important dates. The constant ads make it even more frustrating to use.

Unfortunately, this app doesn’t meet my expectations, and I’ll be deleting it. I hope the developers improve it and make it more inclusive in the future.

reviews.title: Basic features locked behind subscription
reviews.text: I've downloaded so many countdown apps just because I wanted a simple widget on my home screen. But nowadays even the most basic features are locked behind subscriptions or paywalls. I understand apps have costs, servers, development, maintenance, etc. But at this point, it would honestly feel more transparent to just charge upfront for the app instead of advertising it as "free" and then trapping users once they've already set everything up. A simple countdown widget should not require another monthly subscription.
